notes: Eclipse Loop 1.1.0 — now a full studio The big one: Eclipse Loop now bundles three synths and the full 25 FX rack, plus a wave of usability polish. 3 synths, now included - Eclipse Prism — hybrid wavetable + analog synth (scan/load wavetables, analog controls). - Eclipse Alloy — modern dual-engine wavetable synth. - Eclipse Dusk — lofi synth with tape wow/flutter + vinyl noise & crackle. All three ship inside Loop and load into any DAW. Universal (Apple Silicon + Intel). Usability - SAMPLER / SEQUENCER — the two halves of the app are labelled now, so the two REC buttons read in context. - Menus open on left-click — every option button opens its menu on left-click (right-click too); QUANT gets triplet + dotted grids. - One SNAP (the duplicate up top is gone), CLEAR evened up in its row. - View menu mirrors the whole top row with Cmd-1…0 shortcuts. - Analyze BPM / Key report the detected value instead of doing nothing. - Store is now the hub for updates + sound packs (coming soon), no longer selling the bundled synths. - Animated, full-colour pad waveforms. Fixes - Alt-tab / app switching works on the first press. - Pad recording plays at the right pitch; QWERTY + MPC pad keys behave; Cmd-A then Delete no longer wipes the loop. - No duplicate FX plugins in the browser. macOS 12+ · Universal (Apple Silicon + Intel) · Standalone + VST3 + AU
